BiblicalUsage: Once, in Jeremiah's prayer over the field he has just bought in a besieged city: God is great in counsel and mighty in work, His eyes open upon all the ways of the sons of men, to give every one according to his ways and according to the fruit of his doings. The word is the mighty working itself, the execution of God's counsel in the world.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for God's mighty working carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the prayer it sits in, that the God who sees every way also acts in every way, and Jeremiah bought the field because of it.
